scope_rationale: Existing general-host comparison lacks implementation of inspected congestion mechanisms. Six assessed refinements preserve original IDs and accepted evidence.

competencies.title: Admission and sequence ownership
competencies.outcome: Derive live flight, wrap-safe cumulative ACKs, copied-only admission and caller-enforced ownership.
prerequisites: T41.06 copied transport and sequence arithmetic

competencies.title: Growth and ACK division
competencies.outcome: Construct slow start and byte-counting congestion avoidance with independent partition invariance and overflow bounds.
prerequisites: T41.06 copied transport and sequence arithmetic

competencies.title: Loss and recovery
competencies.outcome: Distinguish flight/cwnd, qualify duplicates, preserve one recovery inflation budget, and diagnose Reno multiple-loss and spurious retransmit behavior.
prerequisites: T41.06 copied transport and sequence arithmetic

competencies.title: Limited Transmit and idle
competencies.outcome: Track extra-byte intervals separately, trim partial ACKs, exclude them from fast threshold, and restart by last send rather than last receive.
prerequisites: T41.06 copied transport and sequence arithmetic

competencies.title: Component composition and receiver changes
competencies.outcome: Integrate actual IP/checksum with out-of-order receiver bytes; implement delayed ACK, priority reversal and exact delivered-byte checks.
prerequisites: T41.06 copied transport and sequence arithmetic

competencies.title: Adversarial and resource evidence
competencies.outcome: Reject ACK-inflation mutants, audit target closure and stack, and derive finite-horizon fairness with explicit model limits.
prerequisites: T41.06 copied transport and sequence arithmetic
